title: The Penalty — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Twelve yards. One man with the ball.
One man with no instructions except to stop it.
Eighty thousand people who have already decided.

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
ゴールキーパーはキックの前に飛び込む [The goalkeeper dives before the kick]
八十パーセントの時間、彼は間違った方向に跳ぶ [Eighty percent of the time he guesses wrong]
キッカーはこれを知っている [The kicker knows this]
ゴールキーパーはキッカーがこれを知っていることを知っている [The goalkeeper knows the kicker knows this]
群衆はこれを何も知らない [The crowd knows none of this]
それでも叫ぶ [And screams anyway]

[Chorus — English]
The penalty is the loneliest moment in football
One decision, one direction
The moment it leaves the boot — nothing can bring it back

[Bridge — 中文]
十二码。一个带球的人。 [Twelve yards. One man with the ball.]
一个唯一任务就是阻止它的人。 [One man with no instructions except to stop it.]
罚球是足球中最孤独的时刻 [The penalty is the loneliest moment in football]
一旦球离开靴子 — 没有任何东西能把它带回来 [The moment it leaves the boot — nothing can bring it back]

[Verse 3 — English]
The keeper already knows where it's going
The kicker just hasn't told himself yet

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
The penalty
ペナルティ [The penalty]
点球 [The penalty]
That's my boy
